QuestInfo.name: [Maple Castle] The Hero's Gauntlet
QuestInfo.0: The lightning-quick Angelic Buster is hosting a Hero's Gauntlet! Whatever it is, it sounds rad! Go find out what it actually is.
QuestInfo.1: You readily agreed to try Angelic Buster's Hero's Gauntlet.

default.0: What is wrong with you? The Hero's Gauntlet is RIGHT HERE! It's waiting for YOU! Just click on the #bbrown invitation#k above your head when you get one. You might even get an invitation if you're #bnot in the castle#k. Try it already!
